uutiset.t: Man Utd target Collins - Wednesday's gossip
uutiset.s: Manchester United target Brentford defender Nathan Collins, Bournemouth price forward Eli Junior Kroupi at £100m and Liverpool close in on new Rio Ngumoha contract.

uutiset.t: Bayern hold 'constructive' talks over Musiala's health
uutiset.s: Bayern Munich are only focused on getting Jamal Musiala back from injury and not interested in the comments made regarding his contract, the club's sporting director Max Eberl insists.

uutiset.t: 'I miss being on court' - Sinner has 'minor surgery' on knee
uutiset.s: World number two Jannik Sinner says he has had "minor surgery" on his knee, just seven weeks before January's Australian Open begins.

uutiset.t: Sheehan out of Wallabies Test after two-game ban
uutiset.s: Ireland's stand-in captain Dan Sheehan will be banned for two games after a croc-roll tackle against South Africa and will play no part against Australia on Friday night.

uutiset.t: Klopp advice and Iraola confidence boosts Wirtz
uutiset.s: Florian Wirtz opens up on why it's the best he has felt since joining Liverpool.

uutiset.t: Senegal reinstated as Afcon 2025 winners - 10 months after tournament
uutiset.s: Ten months after the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations final, Senegal are reinstated as champions following a ruling by the Court of Arbitration for Sport.

uutiset.t: Yoro red card overturned, but refs' chief Webb backs decision
uutiset.s: Manchester United defender Leny Yoro is clear to face Brentford on Saturday as his red card at Anfield is overturned.

uutiset.t: FA chief signs NDA to view Fifa sell-off plot documents
uutiset.s: Debbie Hewitt is among several football chiefs to view documents made available by Fifa, but cannot speak about them.
Wales wing Louis Rees-Zammit may not have made the cut in American football, but his gridiron crucible has seen him reformed as an improved version on his rugby union return.

uutiset.t: Sooryavanshi, 15, breaks sixes record by scoring 204 off 53 balls
uutiset.s: India's 15-year-old sensation Vaibhav Sooryavanshi blazes 204 from 53 balls for India A, almost halving the record for the fastest double-century in List A cricket.

uutiset.t: Millwall face partial stadium closure over chants
uutiset.s: Millwall must play a home game in front of a partially-closed stadium as punishment for fans' discriminatory chants.

uutiset.t: Commanders claim late win to come back against Bengals
uutiset.s: Drew Stevens kicks a last-second field goal to see Washington Commanders come back against the Cincinnati Bengals in a close match.

uutiset.t: Women's smaller ball trial extended into second season
uutiset.s: World Rugby extends the women's 4.5 ball trial for a second season after releasing data showing improvements in several areas of the game and receiving "overwhelmingly positive" feedback from players and coaches.

uutiset.t: England seamer Robinson joins Notts from Sussex
uutiset.s: England seamer Ollie Robinson leaves Sussex after 11 years to join Nottinghamshire for an undisclosed "compensation package" on a three-year deal.

uutiset.t: 'The rest of the world noticed' - Welshman Donald demolishes Aussies
uutiset.s: A remarkable opening partnership of 150 in 10 overs between Aneurin Donald and Phil Salt helps England chase 184 against Australia to level the T20 series.
